title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-nov-2024-priya-personal-notes
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Research)
Date: 2024-11-15 (prep notes)
Owner: Priya Shah (notes to self)
Attendees (suggested): Asha (Product), Maya (Eng - Serving Runtime), Raj (Applied ML), Ethan (Infra), Dylan (SRE), Lina (Console PM)

Goal: Surface risks + dependencies between product priorities (Hosted API features, Dedicated capacity improvements, Private deployment controls) and Eng/Research work (compilation/kernel selection, quantization experiments, autoscaling changes). Leave with clear owners for unblockers and data requests.

Agenda (tight 45m):
- 0-5m: Quick status (product priorities + market signals) — Asha
- 5-20m: Eng updates + capacity constraints (Maya) — focus on Dedicated throughput, p95 on 8k seqs, burst plan
- 20-30m: Research updates (Raj) — quantization results, model variant quality regressions, eval gaps
- 30-40m: Cross-team dependencies + rollout plan (Priya lead) — feature gating, fallback policies, infra needs
- 40-45m: Action items + next sync cadence

Key product asks to surface:
- Hosted API: streaming + function-calling priority for PLG demo next quarter — need latency guarantees (p95 < 300ms for 2k seqs) and cost estimate per 1M tokens for benchmark model set
- Dedicated: customers asking for predictable burst capacity & per-route SLAs; product would like autoscale knobs exposed to customers (min/target/max) and a migration path for existing reserved pools
- Private: compliance checklist (KMS/HSM integration, audit logs) — product needs a rollout checklist and timeline to present to sales

Eng/R&D status notes (to verify in sync):
- Serving runtime: kernel fusion experiment landed on branch alpha/kv-fuse; internal perf shows ~18% p50 throughput gain for 4k sequences but degraded memory during warmup — Maya to confirm numbers and heap profile (PR #214).
- Quantization: Raj's eval shows 4-bit QAT on LLaMA-2-like family keeps top-1 answer accuracy within 1.8% on our eval suite but increases hallucination on multi-turn legal prompts — need more eval sets and a regression mitigation strategy (action: Raj to run cross-eval by 11/22).
- Autoscaling: current Dedicated autoscaler triggers too late for sudden burst; SRE proposal to add a short-lived burst pool (cost impact TBD) — ask SRE to model cost vs. SLA benefit (Ethan/Dylan).

Open questions / risks to raise: (note: keep short — will ask owners in meeting)
- Can serving runtime commit to upgrade schedule for kernel fusion/compilation changes? (risk: changes may break Private deployments on older infra)
- How confident are we in quantized-model fallbacks? Do we need automated AB tests before rolling out to Hosted customers?
- Data needs: product wants per-route cost estimates for common customer workloads — need sample traffic traces + token distributions (requesting from Console team).
- Compliance timeline uncertainty for Private customers in EMEA — legal may require extra validation steps.

Metrics / numbers to bring: (placeholders to confirm pre-meeting)
- Current p50/p95 latency Hosted API (prod avg, 2k seqs): p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 420ms (confirm)
- Dedicated throughput 8x A100: baseline 450 tok/s per GPU for baseline model -> need updated perf matrix from Maya by 11/14
- Cost per 1M tokens (baseline model, hosted): $X (ask finance for estimate)

Pre-meeting TODO (me / others):
- Priya: consolidate latest perf slides (2 slides) + one pager on product asks (due 11/14)
- Maya: bring perf numbers for alpha/kv-fuse (p50/p95, memory) + pointer to PR #214 (due 11/14)
- Raj: summarized quantization eval (top-line numbers + known regression cases) + plan for additional evals (due 11/22)
- Ethan/Dylan: SRE cost model for burst pool (first pass by 11/20)
- Asha: list of priority Hosted routes (top 10 by traffic) and PLG demo requirements (due 11/14)
- Lina: sample console UI mock for exposing autoscale knobs (if available)

Action items (capture during sync and move to JIRA after):
- ACTION-1: Maya -> validate kernel fusion memory regression and produce rollback criteria (owner: Maya, due: 2024-11-21)
- ACTION-2: Raj -> run extended eval on legal + multi-turn prompts comparing FP16 vs 4-bit QAT (owner: Raj, due: 2024-11-22)
- ACTION-3: Ethan/Dylan -> draft cost vs SLA model for burst pool and provide recommendation (owner: Ethan, Dylan; due: 2024-11-20)
- ACTION-4: Priya/Asha -> produce customer-facing migration notes for Dedicated reserved pools if autoscale change is required (due: 2024-11-29)
- ACTION-5: Lina -> prototype console controls + include telemetry hooks for cost/latency (due: 2024-11-28)

Notes-to-self / agenda script snippets:
- "We want to avoid surprising Private customers with runtime changes — can we propose a compatibility matrix and a deprecation window?"
- "For PLG demo we need streaming + function-calling working end-to-end; if latency can't be guaranteed, propose a staged rollout with canary on Dedicated."
- Keep the sync focused on unblockers (yes/no), not deep debugging — will create follow-up breakout for perf deep dive if needed.

Follow-ups after meeting (expected):
- Convert action items to JIRA tickets (PLAT-4123 family) and link to Confluence page
- Schedule perf deep-dive with serving runtime + SRE (30–60m) if kernel fusion shows mem regression
- Create short playbook for fallback policies (pinned model variants) to present to sales and support

Random scratch / thoughts (informal):
- Might be good to surface a small customer story where Dedicated burst would have prevented an incident — ask CS for a redacted example
- Consider adding a short "cost guardrails" slide in the deck: show impact of burst pool vs pre-warmed instances
- Remember to ask Raj whether retraining + QAT pipeline will be repeatable on customer-managed Private infra (ops risk)

End of notes.

-- Priya
(quick & rough; will tidy after sync)
